top_signals.title: Uber and Waymo to end exclusivity arrangement in Atlanta and Austin
top_signals.summary: In Atlanta and Austin, Texas, Waymo driverless rides will be available on platforms other than Uber starting in 2028.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
